summary: Iteration 54: Full testing of CFO Virtual (Credit Recovery & Restructuring) module. Backend: 22/24 pytest tests passed (2 skipped because bank statement is loaded). Frontend: All UI elements verified working correctly - page loads, KPIs display real data, debt CRUD works, AI analysis generates structured reports, simulator runs projections, anti-illusion rule enforced.

issues: Console warning about chart dimensions (-1x-1) when chart container not fully visible - cosmetic only, chart renders correctly when scrolled into view

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/cfo-virtual/dashboard returns comprehensive financial context: snapshot, context_validation, debts, urgent_receivables, work_margin_opportunities, cash_allocation, recent_transactions
Snapshot includes: current_cash, allocatable_cash_now, monthly_fixed_costs, active_debt_total, overdue_debt_total, urgent_receivables_total, crisis_level, runway_days
Context validation flags: can_generate_analysis, bank_statement_loaded, fixed_costs_ready, debt_collection_ready
Debt CRUD fully functional: POST creates with validation (tipo_divida, valor_total > 0), PUT updates, DELETE removes
POST /api/cfo-virtual/analyze generates AI report with: executive_diagnosis, cost_surgery_actions, tactical_treasury_plan, orders_of_day
POST /api/cfo-virtual/simulator returns projection with: limits, assumptions, projection array, recovery_month, commentary
Anti-illusion rule enforced: cash_allocation is empty when allocatable_cash_now <= 0
Simulator respects limits: effective_cut <= max_cut_feasible, effective_collection <= max_urgent_collection
Both analyze and simulator endpoints block with 400 if no bank statement loaded
All frontend data-testid attributes present and functional for automated testing
seed_data_creation: Test debt created and deleted during testing. No persistent test data left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CFO Virtual module fully tested. Key endpoints: GET /api/cfo-virtual/dashboard (returns full financial context), GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/cfo-virtual/debts (debt CRUD), POST /api/cfo-virtual/analyze (AI analysis), POST /api/cfo-virtual/simulator (financial projection). Frontend data-testids: cfo-virtual-page, cfo-kpi-*, validation-*, cfo-crisis-level, cfo-analysis-panel, cfo-cash-allocation-panel, cfo-receivables-panel, cfo-work-opportunities-panel, cfo-debts-section, cfo-simulator-section, run-cfo-analysis, new-debt-button, save-debt-button, run-simulator-button, simulator-chart, sim-commentary. Current test data shows negative cash (-306€), zero free cash, crisis_level='critical', anti-illusion rule active (no payment suggestions).
